_about: Short excerpts copied from the IRS PDFs in /sources. These are the only texts the app may cite. Later milestones add excerpts from the Form 1041 instructions.

excerpts.text: Enter taxable interest not included in box 3.

excerpts.section: Box 3. Interest on U.S. Savings Bonds and Treasury Obligations
excerpts.text: Enter interest on U.S. Savings Bonds, Treasury bills, Treasury notes, and Treasury bonds. Do not include in box 1.
Enter any foreign tax paid on interest. Report this amount in U.S. dollars.
Enter tax-exempt interest that is not OID of $10 or more that is credited or paid to the person's account […]

excerpts.section: Box 9. Specified Private Activity Bond Interest
excerpts.text: Enter interest of $10 or more from specified private activity bonds.
Enter dividends, including dividends from money market funds, net short-term capital gains from mutual funds, and other distributions on stock.
Enter the portion of the dividends in box 1a that qualifies for the reduced capital gains rates.
Enter total capital gain distributions (long-term). Include all amounts shown in boxes 2b, 2c, 2d, and 2f.
Enter the qualified REIT dividends paid by a REIT or section 199A dividends paid by a RIC to the recipient. This amount is included in the amount reported in box 1a.
Enter foreign tax paid on dividends and other distributions on stock.
Enter exempt-interest dividends from a mutual fund or other RIC.
Enter the gross cash proceeds from all dispositions (including short sales) of securities, commodities, options, securities futures contracts, or forward contracts.
Enter the adjusted basis of any securities sold unless the security is not a covered security and you check box 5.
Report wash sale loss amount disallowed.

excerpts.section: Box 2. Type of Gain or Loss
excerpts.text: Determine whether the gain or loss is short-term or long-term under section 1222, and whether any portion of the gain or loss is ordinary.
